cardEditor.title: Your allergen card
cardEditor.intro: Customers see this exactly as you write it — nothing is rewritten. Type or paste below, or upload a photo/PDF and we’ll read the text in for you to check.
cardEditor.placeholder: e.g. All our fish & chips contain wheat and milk. Fryer is shared with items containing gluten and nuts. Vegan options available — ask staff.
cardEditor.uploadNote: We read the text off your image so you can review it — the image isn’t stored.
